evidence: Proposed acceptance criteria fixed before inference; not measured native timing
scope: Complete local excerpts no longer than 60 seconds; line-level preparation first
candidates: TIFA 1.0 ST, CPU, default skip penalty 0.5
facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h, CPU, CTC Viterbi without fitted phase correction

selection.Japanese: PJS 001–006, independent human relabeling; 001–002 development, 003–006 held out
selection.English: JamendoLyrics: first three complete annotated lines from Lower Loveday (development), Rxbyn and Cortez (held out), two-second context margins
selection.exclusions: No selection based on model performance. Report any unavailable or rejected example. No per-recording tuning. Corpus annotation boundaries define evaluation excerpts, limiting full-song generality.

secondary: Report English word and Japanese phone onset/offset errors where correspondence is unambiguous. No general fine-grained qualification from line-level success.
uncertainty: Single Japanese singer; English accompaniment and different singers; TIFA undisclosed private training overlap unknown. Human annotations have unquantified inter-annotator uncertainty.
corpus_correction: Before corrected inference, trailing context was bounded by the midpoint to the next annotated line; initial two-second margins contained omitted following words. Initial measurements are retained separately as mismatch diagnostics. No parameter adjustment. EN02 has no interline gap; its final offset is at the excerpt endpoint and cannot independently qualify offset accuracy.
